hero.title: Fixed Wing Drones
lead: Aerial mapping, surveying, inspection, security ops…

blocks.html: Our fixed-wing drones fly at higher altitudes and carry more weight to perform any operation you require. Designed to look and work like an aero-plane, this drone only needs the energy to move forward and not to hold itself in the air, making it highly energy efficient.

Our innovative drones can cover longer distances and map much larger areas, while lingering for longer periods monitoring their point of interest. And when the weather gets rough, they are tough enough to handle it, thanks to their simple structure that’s also easy to get maintained.
